description: Returns what an image set would cost before anything is spent: its shots (default: the plan’s ticked ones), or with locales the cost of translating the finished set, or with colours the cost of its colour versions. Also returns the balance. Free. Tell the person the cost before generate_image_set, localize_image_set or recolour_image_set. Example: {"image_set_id": "…", "shots": ["main-white", "lifestyle"]}

colours.description: Instead: the cost of these colour versions

locales.description: Instead: the cost of translating into these

shots.description: Shot keys from the plan; default: the ticked ones
